results.title: CRISPR interference
results.content:
#### Multiplexed gene knockdown

CRISPRi synthetic sgRNA offers a unique method for the simultaneous knockdown of multiple genes (figure 6). Each guide RNA binds to its specific DNA target independently and relies on exogenously supplied dCas9 fusion protein, thereby minimizing any competition for endogenous pathways. Our scientists have validated the effectiveness of multiplex CRISPRi in iPSC cells. [...] ###### CRISPRi gene repression is observed 24 hours post-transfection and is maximal 48-72
